run_model_evaluation: run the evaluate script to evaluate a trained MERU or CLIP model checkpoint
run_evaluation_with_config: run the evaluate script with a config file and checkpoint path to get evaluation metrics
load_checkpoint_and_evaluate: load a model checkpoint and run evaluation using a Hydra-instantiated evaluator
build_model_from_config: build a model from a training config using LazyFactory and load a checkpoint onto it
load_config_and_evaluate: load evaluation and training configs then run the evaluator on the loaded model
